_readme: An append-only correction. Applying it records rows in the
event_corrections ledger; it never edits or deletes an observation.
The affected ids are written out literally and not recomputed from a
rule: a correction that can match new events on its own is not a
correction, it is a filter, and it would keep excluding things forever.
Applying this file twice is a no-op -- correction ids are content-
addressed, so the second run writes nothing.
source_bug: Event identity was derived from the freshly retrieved document's available_at rather than the availability the store already held for it, so re-reading an unchanged feed produced a new event on every cycle. Fixed by IntelligenceStore.canonical_availability in ec4d1c8.
notes: One duplicate per source document, all three written by the 09:01Z cycle on 2026-09-02. The 08:39Z cycle produced the genuine observations and the 09:18Z cycle, first to run with the fix, produced none. The set is therefore closed.
